Subject: Internal: Bridgewell evidence pack and recommended replies

Internal note — drafting the 1-page summary and residency matrix now. Rapid checklist for the response pack (so Legal/InfoSec have explicit answers):

1) DPA redline status
   - dpa_redline_v2.pdf contains our standing redline. It includes a Data Residency Exhibit (section X) that allows region pinning to US-East or US-West for hosted; we can add an explicit EU residency exhibit for EU-only customers (requires additional attestation).

2) Subprocessor inventory
   - subprocessor_inventory_20270402.xlsx contains names, roles, locations, and whether they handle customer data (processing vs non-processing). Key entries: AWS (us-east-1/us-west-2), S3 replication to EU for analytics (opt-in), Segment (telemetry pseudonymized), PagerDuty, Datadog. We must call out managed inference pool provider (Redwood Dedicated partner) — currently US-only but can be mapped to EU partner for AP/EMEA customers.

3) Export controls & encryption export statement
   - Short point: We do not transfer controlled cryptographic tech outside jurisdictions where export license would be required. Our default SDKs and runtime use AES-256 and standard TLS; for customers with export constraints we offer KMS key policies and a Private deployment so keys never leave tenant boundary.

4) Deployment options + lead times
   - Hosted (region pinning): fastest; evidence pack in 2 business days.
   - Dedicated (reserved capacity): moderate lead time (2–4 weeks) depending on GPU pool availability and contract signature.
   - Private (VPC/on-prem): longest (6–12+ weeks) and often requires a statement of work.

5) Artifacts to include for Legal
   - DPA redline PDF, subprocessor spreadsheet, residency_options_matrix.csv, SOC2 attestation PDF (redacted), BAA exhibit draft if HIPAA applies.

Action: Laura — can you attach SOC2 and the BAA exhibit draft. Marcus — confirm whether the Dedicated partner for Bridgewell's region has an EU mapping or if it's US-only. Olga — propose Tue 10:00 AM PT time for a 30-minute sync with Bridgewell?

Irene Choi
